text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Your first report was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: gate kiosks offline at Hartford, with both inbound lanes white-screening after badge scan. In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

The brain also has ticket SUP-5380 for the same outage, with an 08:12 update saying the reconnect had failed and drivers were queueing. That is earlier than anything in the channel. I couldn't see who wrote that update, so check the ticket before the postmortem.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: It's INC-4821. Gideon's 11:08 AM post on 3 Aug says the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem is attached there. I haven't opened the ticket itself, so that comes from the channel message. I replied in the thread.
